crossRefs.note: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
“I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
“I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to…

translations.web: I have said these things to you while still living with you.
translations.bsb: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.
translations.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
translations.asv: These things have I spoken unto you, while yet abiding with you.
